The workflow, end to end

Everything a grid needs, in one place.

Build, edit, connect, and orthogonalize — an iterative workflow shaped around how modelers actually work, with the model run always one click away.

01 / BUILD

Build complex grids, fast

Construct discrete grid blocks straight from georeferenced data, and iterate freely on resolution, IJ orientation, and orthogonality — every experiment backed by robust undo/redo.

  • Rectangular & radial grid forms
  • Curvilinear orthogonal or Cartesian
  • Live online background maps
  • Extensive shortcut-key library
02 / EDIT

Refine without starting over

Import an existing EFDC+ grid, keep its I,J map intact, and make targeted edits — add, delete, or deactivate cells, reposition nodes, coarsen, refine, and fit to real land boundaries.

  • Preserve original grid structure
  • Smooth, telescope & regularize
  • Live grid-quality metrics
  • Fit to complex coastlines
03 / CONNECT

Assemble grids modularly

When a domain is too intricate for one grid, build sub-grids and stitch them into a single unified grid — save each piece, then show, hide, split, and reassemble as the model demands.

  • Connect multiple grids seamlessly
  • Save & manage sub-grids as files
  • Split existing grids to refine
  • Purpose-built for river networks
04 / ORTHOGONALIZE

Grid quality, automated

Minimize orthogonal deviation across the whole domain or within targeted sub-regions, using advanced algorithms — including methods comparable to those in RGFGrid.

  • One-click global optimization
  • Local refinement of problem areas
  • Direct download of online bathymetry
  • Fewer numerical errors, better results
